description:
### Kizu 2.0.1-beta.25

- Replaces the brittle Twitch private autocomplete-provider hook with a PurpleTV-style independent chat-input suggestion strip.
- Finds the chat input by its resource entry name and uses Kizu's existing 7TV/BTTV/FFZ catalog.
- Adds starts-with-first, then contains, matching; refreshes suggestions when catalogs or emote images finish loading.
- Keeps the current native autocomplete trigger adjustment. Test-only prerelease; stable v2.0.0 is unchanged.
